text_block_list.text: During lunch break, while heading to the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ Hello there, King-chan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, you came at just the right time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's lunch break, but do you mind if I
borrow the Trainer's Office for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I have a quiz coming up soon. I was planning
to study for it, but—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, there wasn't a single quiet place available where I could study.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So with that in mind, Trainer,
I bestow upon you the privilege of lending your room to King and her peers!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like I can really focus on studying here.
Nice idea, if I do say so myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's do our best
to conquer your weak subjects.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do our best~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you talking about?!
It's the exact opposite!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san asked me to help her study today,
so I'm going to tutor her!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are some applied math problems I'm unsure about,
so King-chan is going to help me with them.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, Grass-san does have top-tier grades,
so it's hard to imagine her being tutored by someone,
but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But you know, my grades are always top-class too!
That's right! I'm first-rate at studying, as well!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: King-chan really is brilliant, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She always gets high scores on tests, and the teachers trust her completely.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "However, more than anything, that attitude of tackling difficult problems head-on is wonderful~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Calling it wonderful...
Oh stop, though it's totally true!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, do you see now? King is just as exceptional as Grass-san!
choice_data_list: You two make good rivals in studying as well, huh?
You two make good rivals in studying too, don't you?
So which one is actually better?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, do you see now? King is just as exceptional as Grass-san!
choice_data_list: You two make good rivals in studying as well, huh?
You two make good rivals in studying too, don't you?
So which one is actually better?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! Whether in studying or racing, we are rivals who elevate one another!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Grass-san, let's strive together to be first-class Umamusume,
and take flight into the world as a first-class duo!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh, spread our wings as a duo...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Together, we can pioneer a brand new, 
first-class genre! Ohohoho!

As good rivals, the two pushed each other
to excel in both their studies and their racing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
...G-Grass, please...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, though!
I'll completely turn the tables on the next quiz!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Then I must do my best
and not let my guard down either~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
Allow me to show you the King's sweeping comeback!

"Even while letting their rivalry show,
the two continued to study and learn from each other."
